name: Tiimo
one_liner: Visual daily planner built with neurodivergent people: colour-coded timeline, AI task planning, focus timer and widgets.
best_for: Teens and adults with ADHD or autism who plan better with a visual timeline
People who want help breaking a to-do list into a day plan
Families who want separate profiles on one account
not_for: People looking for ADHD diagnosis or treatment
People who want a fully free planner on Android or web (free version is iOS only)
Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
short_description: Visual planner app for ADHD and autism with a colour-coded schedule, AI co-planner and focus timer; limited free version on iOS, Pro by subscription.
long_description: Tiimo, made by Danish company tiimo ApS, is a visual planning app designed with neurodivergent people. You plan your day on a colour-coded timeline, dump tasks into a to-do list that an AI co-planner helps sort and prioritise, and use a focus countdown, widgets and Apple Calendar and Reminders sync. Up to five profiles can share an account. It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Android and a web planner. A limited free version is available only in the iOS app; Pro (needed for Android, web and all features) costs $12 a month or $54 a year in the US App Store, with a 7-day trial on the yearly plan. Its privacy policy says it does not sell personal data, but its App Store privacy label says identifiers may be used to track you across other companies' apps and websites. It is a planning tool, not a treatment, and has no published studies.
patient_summary: You lay out your day on a colour-coded visual timeline, add tasks that an AI helper can sort, and use a focus timer to get started and keep going. There is a limited free version on iPhone; Pro costs about $12 a month or $54 a year in the US, with a 7-day trial on the yearly plan. It helps with planning, not with diagnosing or treating ADHD.

pricing.notes: US App Store prices; prices vary by country. 7-day free trial only with the yearly plan. Free version is iOS only; Android and the web planner need Pro. No lifetime option found.

privacy.notes: Policy says it does not sell personal data, but the App Store privacy label says identifiers may be used to track you across other companies' apps and websites.

seo.title: Tiimo: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Tiimo is a visual daily planner designed with neurodivergent people, with colour-coded schedules, an AI co-planner and a focus timer.

faqs.a: Free; Pro up to about $60/year or $99.99 lifetime. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Tiimo before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Tiimo replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Tiimo is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Tiimo is available on iPhone and Android.
